description: This file contains implementation of a JSON writer utility in C. It provides functions for initializing, releasing, and building JSON objects and arrays with support for pretty printing and string escaping.

methods.name: void append_quoted_string(struct strbuf * out,const char * in)
methods.description: Escapes special characters and appends a JSON-quoted string to the output buffer.

methods.name: void indent_pretty(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Adds indentation for pretty-printed JSON.

methods.name: void begin(struct json_writer * jw,char ch_open,int pretty)
methods.description: Starts a new JSON object or array, updating the open stack and JSON buffer.

methods.name: void assert_in_object(const struct json_writer * jw,const char * key)
methods.description: Checks if current context is an object, triggers a bug if not.

methods.name: void assert_in_array(const struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Checks if current context is an array, triggers a bug if not.

methods.name: void maybe_add_comma(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Adds a comma before new JSON elements if needed.

methods.name: void fmt_double(struct json_writer * jw,int precision,double value)
methods.description: Formats a double value with specified precision and appends it to JSON buffer.

methods.name: void object_common(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key)
methods.description: Common procedure to add key-value pair for objects, handling formatting and punctuation.

methods.name: void array_common(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Prepares array context for adding new elements, handling formatting and punctuation.

methods.name: void assert_is_terminated(const struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Ensures that the current JSON object or array has been properly closed.

methods.name: void jw_object_begin(struct json_writer * jw,int pretty)
methods.description: Starts a new JSON object, with optional pretty printing.

methods.name: void jw_object_string(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key,const char * value)
methods.description: Adds a string key-value pair to a JSON object.

methods.name: void jw_object_intmax(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key,intmax_t value)
methods.description: Adds an integer key-value pair to a JSON object.

methods.name: void jw_object_double(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key,int precision,double value)
methods.description: Adds a double (floating point) key-value pair to a JSON object.

methods.name: void jw_object_true(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key)
methods.description: Adds a key with boolean true value to an object.

methods.name: void jw_object_false(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key)
methods.description: Adds a key with boolean false value to an object.

methods.name: void jw_object_bool(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key,int value)
methods.description: Adds a boolean value (true or false) to a JSON object.

methods.name: void jw_object_null(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key)
methods.description: Adds a null value for a key in a JSON object.

methods.name: void increase_indent(struct strbuf * sb,const struct json_writer * jw,int indent)
methods.description: Increases indentation for nested JSON elements in pretty mode.

methods.name: void kill_indent(struct strbuf * sb,const struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Removes indentation from nested JSON elements to compact format.

methods.name: void append_sub_jw(struct json_writer * jw,const struct json_writer * value)
methods.description: Appends a sub-JSON writer's buffer with correct indentation depending on context.

methods.name: void jw_object_sub_jw(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key,const struct json_writer * value)
methods.description: Adds a nested JSON object or array as a value for a key.

methods.name: void jw_object_inline_begin_object(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key)
methods.description: Begins an inline JSON object for the given key.

methods.name: void jw_object_inline_begin_array(struct json_writer * jw,const char * key)
methods.description: Begins an inline JSON array for the given key.

methods.name: void jw_array_begin(struct json_writer * jw,int pretty)
methods.description: Starts a new JSON array, with optional pretty printing.

methods.name: void jw_array_string(struct json_writer * jw,const char * value)
methods.description: Adds a string element to a JSON array.

methods.name: void jw_array_intmax(struct json_writer * jw,intmax_t value)
methods.description: Adds an integer element to a JSON array.

methods.name: void jw_array_double(struct json_writer * jw,int precision,double value)
methods.description: Adds a double element to a JSON array.

methods.name: void jw_array_true(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Adds a boolean true element to a JSON array.

methods.name: void jw_array_false(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Adds a boolean false element to a JSON array.

methods.name: void jw_array_bool(struct json_writer * jw,int value)
methods.description: Adds a boolean element (true or false) to a JSON array.

methods.name: void jw_array_null(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Adds a null element to a JSON array.

methods.name: void jw_array_sub_jw(struct json_writer * jw,const struct json_writer * value)
methods.description: Adds a nested JSON object or array as an array element.

methods.name: void jw_array_argc_argv(struct json_writer * jw,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Adds array elements from argc and argv parameters.

methods.name: void jw_array_argv(struct json_writer * jw,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Adds array elements from a NULL-terminated array of strings.

methods.name: void jw_array_inline_begin_object(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Begins an inline JSON object inside an array.

methods.name: void jw_array_inline_begin_array(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Begins an inline JSON array inside an array.

methods.name: int jw_is_terminated(const struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Checks if current JSON object or array is properly terminated.

methods.name: void jw_end(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: Ends the current JSON object or array, closing brackets and updating open stack.

methods.name: void jw_init(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void jw_release(struct json_writer * jw)
methods.description: unavailable
